entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. My order number is VF-881-2947.
Okay, just a moment while I pull that up... VF-881-2947. Got it. I see an order for a pair of our Pro-Series cycling shoes.
That's them. I need to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They just don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but they're still giving me terrible blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that they're causing discomfort. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery was 78 days ago.
Right. So can I return them or not?

Yes, you can. For our standard items, like these cycling shoes, we have a 10-day return policy. You're unfortunately outside that window, so I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you.
Great. Finally. What's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
